_doc: Business-justification text templates per ticket category. Placeholders: {asset}, {user}, {ticket}, {window_start}, {window_end}. Pick one at random per ticket. The 'vague' pool drives scenario S2.
application_restart: Restart the application service on {asset} to clear a memory pressure incident raised by ops monitoring earlier today. Limited to systemctl restart plus health checks. No data changes. Rollback: revert to previous service state.

Routine restart of the Tomcat instance on {asset} as part of the weekly maintenance window {window_start} to {window_end}. Implementer: {user}. No configuration changes; pre- and post-restart health probes will be captured for ticket {ticket}.

Restart application processes on {asset} after the deployment of build 2026.05.04 to flush stale connection pools. The change has been validated in pre-prod. Backout: roll back to the previous build via the standard release pipeline.

OS-level critical CVE remediation on {asset}. Limited to vendor-supplied security errata. No application changes. Reboot at the end of the window. Rollback: snapshot taken before patching.
Routine kernel patch on {asset} per the security baseline. Standard pre-checks (uptime, df), package update, reboot, post-checks. Ticket {ticket}.

Routine routing table refresh on {asset}. Read-only verification (ip route, ss, ping) plus a single static route addition. No services restarted.
incident_remediation: Investigate the alert raised by the SIEM at 02:14 on {asset}. Initial triage only: log review, system metrics, no remediation actions. Findings to be appended to ticket {ticket}.
Respond to incident INC-2026-0042: connectivity loss reported by app-payments. Read-only diagnostics on {asset}; remediation actions will be a separate change. Implementer: {user}.
Triage of the disk-full alarm on {asset}. Read-only investigation: df, du, log inspection. No file deletions; if recovery is required raise a follow-up change.

Diagnostic maintenance window on {asset}. Captures EXPLAIN plans for the slow queries flagged by the platform team; one optional CREATE INDEX may be added subject to approval. Strict no-DELETE / no-DROP policy outside approved migrations.
